evidence: Carries the 'Block storage' label and modifies blockfile cursor classification and validation logic across src/node/blockstorage.cpp and src/validation.cpp.
rationale: Prevents an assertion abort during background validation and startup failure falsely claiming database corruption when using assumeutxo. If a node receives the snapshot base block before snapshot activation, the base block was improperly reclassified, triggering an assertion failure in `WriteBlockUndo` or causing `VerifyDB` to report database corruption requiring an unnecessary reindex.
